_comment: MostWanted's website API and Discord bot (backend/), for Raptor. Import it on the Eggs page: docs/12-launch.md.
name: MostWanted API
author: contact@xenastudios.co
description: The website's API and the Discord bot, one Java app, from the latest build of github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted. Reinstall to update. It uses the game server's database: its details go on the Startup tab.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MostWanted's API and Discord bot: the latest build (the "server" release, from
# main). Reinstall in Raptor to update. tls/origin.pem and tls/origin.key are yours
# to write (Files tab); they're never replaced here.
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates >/dev/null
work=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL -o "$work/api.tar.gz" "https://github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted/releases/download/${RELEASE}/mostwanted-api.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$work/api.tar.gz" -C "$work"
echo "MostWanted build $(cat "$work/COMMIT")"
cp "$work/backend.jar" "$work/start.sh" /mnt/server/
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tls
# Cloudflare's Authenticated Origin Pulls CA: only Cloudflare gets through (docs/12-launch.md, step 6).
curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/tls/cloudflare-origin-pull-ca.pem https://developers.cloudflare.com/ssl/static/authenticated_origin_pull_ca.pem
rm -rf "$work"
echo "Installed. Before the first start: the Startup tab's settings, and tls/origin.pem and tls/origin.key on the Files tab."

variables.name: Build
variables.description: Which build to install: a release on github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted. "server" is always the latest from main. Reinstall to get it.

variables.name: Game database host
variables.description: The game server's database's Host (its Databases tab), like mostwanted.db.raptor.

variables.name: Game database name
variables.description: The game server's database (its Databases tab), like s3e4f5a6b7c8d_mostwanted.

variables.name: Game database user
variables.description: Its user: the same as its name.

variables.name: Game database password
variables.description: Its password (Password on the game server's Databases tab). Reset it there? Put the new one here too.

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: The bot's token (Discord developer portal → Bot). Empty turns the bot off.

variables.name: Discord client secret
variables.description: For "Sign in with Discord" (developer portal → OAuth2). Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Website
variables.description: The website, where sign-in sends people back to.

variables.name: Website origins
variables.description: Sites allowed to call the API with cookies, comma-separated.

variables.name: API address
variables.description: Where the API is reached, for Discord's sign-in to come back to.

variables.name: Cookie domain
variables.description: So the website and the API share the sign-in cookie.

variables.name: Behind Cloudflare
variables.description: true: visitors' addresses come from Cloudflare's header (rate limits per visitor).

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: For the month and week leaderboards: the same as the game's clock.timezone.

variables.name: TLS certificate
variables.description: Cloudflare's Origin Certificate, PEM, written on the Files tab.

variables.name: Cloudflare pull CA
variables.description: Only connections with Cloudflare's client certificate get through. The install downloads it.
